headline: I Am Currently Using My Sensex Portfolio As A Paper Mache Base For My Son’s Science Project
body:
I didn't panic when the Sensex tumbled 900 points today; I just realized that my meticulously researched portfolio had finally achieved its true, highest utility: as structural integrity for a model of the solar system. By 11:00 AM, my brokerage app had become so red it looked like a heatmap of a localized fire, and my wife was already stressing about the upcoming school deadline. It was then I realized that instead of watching my net worth evaporate, I could fold my printouts into a sturdy, papier-mâché Saturn.

There is something strangely liberating about taking a spreadsheet of 'Blue Chip' stocks and drowning it in a bucket of glue and flour. I’ve spent the last three years staring at these tickers like they were holy scripture, agonizing over every 50-point dip. Now, I find that a handful of Nifty 50 derivative statements make an excellent, lightweight core for a scale model of the sun. It has more substance now than it ever did when it was just digits on a screen.

My son is delighted, mostly because he finally has enough 'trash' to finish his project by tomorrow morning. I’ve even started categorizing his planet replicas based on my sector losses—the heavy oil stocks make a surprisingly dense Jupiter, while my tech-heavy mutual funds are perfectly suited for a wispy, ethereal Neptune. If the market drops another 500 points tomorrow, we might even be able to squeeze in a Pluto.
caption: When the market goes red, you have to get creative. Who knew a lifetime of savings could look so good as a celestial body? 📈🎨 #Sensex #StockMarketIndia #DIYProjects #Nifty50 #InvestingHumor (satire)
